_comment: GATE 1 (docs/SPEC_lane_spectrometer.md §9.1) — OFF byte-identity arm for every knob
fix_min_ffr, fix_max_frac_cyc, fix_sigma_floor_m.  All five default false/inert, so
this config is the golden wl1off arm VERBATIM and its artifacts must reproduce
The ONLY key changed from the parent is product_output_path — pointed at this arm's
own directory so the comparison cannot overwrite the stored golden it is measured
against.  (Its `G` generation-timestamp record differs by construction, and several
service CSVs are APPEND-mode, which is why logs/ is cleared per arm.)
What a difference here would mean: the campaign touches SHARED paths —
builder's group split and the pred_m split), NetworkDdFrac.cpp (the anchor emit),
NetworkRunTraces.cpp (two stream opens), NetworkTeardown.cpp (the readout).  Standing
invariant #6 requires this arm to be compared SAME-BUILD; a Debug-vs-Release or
cross-build comparison is meaningless at the ppm level.
